thread:
elaine: FYI - uploaded a new Figma frame with a reflow for Autoscale controls. Key idea: move SLO slider above min/max so users set reliability target first before capacity.

matt: :eyes: saw it. Quick thought — putting SLO first might make the page feel top-heavy. Can we visually de-emphasize it? smaller track, subtle label.

samir: If SLO drives autoscale decisions we should keep it prominent. Also need clear tooltip explaining what % actually means for headroom and cost.

kevin: Accessibility : a11y nit — slider needs an aria-valuetext that clarifies "SLO 99.5% latency under Xms". Also keyboard increments should be 0.1 not 1.

ana: +1 on tooltip for cost. Also concerned about burst: current chip is similar to "priority" tag, users might confuse the two. Maybe rename burst -> "burst buffer"?

matt: Agree rename. UX: show a subtle divider between SLO controls and pool selection. Pool cards should have a clear priority badge (Primary/Secondary) and be keyboard-focusable.

elaine: Decision proposal: SLO first (compact), then min/max steppers + burst buffer control next to them, then pool picker. Keep cost-preview inline under steppers.

samir: Implementation detail — when pool is secondary we should gray out burst option and show tooltip "Burst not supported on this pool". Also add a small fallback indicator if chosen pool lacks capacity.

kevin: Example aria for the slider:
```
aria-label="SLO target"
aria-valuetext="99.5 percent success within 250 milliseconds"
role="slider"
```
Make sure that matches visible copy.

matt: Copy tweaks: instead of "min/max" use "Min instances / Max instances" for clarity. For burst buffer say "Burst buffer (temporary extra GPUs)". Cost preview label: "Estimated cost at current SLO".

ana: UX edge-case: what if user lowers SLO but keeps min high? Should we show a warning banner "You may be over-provisioning for this SLO" with a suggested min.

elaine: Love the warning banner idea. Can be a non-blocking inline banner with suggestion button "Apply recommended min".

samir: One more perf thought — prefix KV caching settings in advanced section. Don't surface on main autoscale panel to keep cognitive load low.

matt: Visual token: add a small icon for "recommended" next to suggested values. Also animate the cost preview update so it feels responsive.

kevin: Final a11y checklis t from me: labels, value text for dynamic cost, keyboard order (SLO -> Min -> Max -> Burst -> Pool), focus styles, and screenreader announcement when recommendations appear.

elaine: Great checklist. I'll update the Figma and add annotations. @matt can you take the copy updates? @samir can you prototype the disabled-burst state?

matt: On it, will push copy edits by EOD. :thumbsup:

samir: I'll wire up prototype state for capacity mismatch and the fallback indicator by tomorrow.

design-bot: Uploaded file: https://figma.com/file/xyz/autoscale-reflow (frame: SLO-first)

elaine: Thanks all — we'll reconvene in next design sync if any new concerns. :party_parrot:
